dct_description_sm: To develop an understanding of existing condition of Etobicoke Creek watershed, the natural cover and wetland layer is necessary to perform QA/QC to check whether they still reflect the existing condition or not. The verified layers will be used to create refined wetland layer and refined natural cover layer for Etobicoke Creek Watershed Plan project.The QA/QC mainly focus on visual checking whether the natural cover and wetland polygon match the 2019 Scoop image. Since ELC wetland and MNRF wetland was checked for updating regulation limit criteria layer (wetland AOI) in 2019, the corresponding historical action layer can be used as a reference to perform QA/QC.
